question_text:
Choose the incorrect statement/s from the following:
a)
The National Physical Laboratory is situated in Lucknow.
b)
Indian Research Station ‘Himadri’ is located in Arctic region.
c)
Central Food Technological Research Institute is located in Mysore.
d)
Central Rice Research Institute is located in Bhubaneswar.

a)


d)

